me.title: Me
me.persona: Who you are in the demo
me.nameBody: Tengo comes from mutengo, the Tshivenda word for value. This meaning was supplied by the founder and is still to be confirmed by a Tshivenda speaker.

how.1: It splits your history into income, regular bills and everyday spending.
how.2: It works out your usual daily spend from the last 60 days, plus a light week and a heavy week.
how.3: It finds when your next money usually lands and how much it usually is.
how.4: It runs your balance down day by day, taking off bills on their dates, until it reaches zero. That day is your date.
how.5: It compares that date with your next money to set your cover: Enough, Tight or Short.

sim.data: All people and money are fictional composites.
sim.bank: There is no bank connection and no open banking.
sim.messages: Messages are previews. Nothing is sent.
sim.privacy: Privacy controls show good practice. They are not a compliance certification.
sim.translations: Built for 11 languages. English today. The other 10 need translating and checking by first-language speakers, and Tshivenda needs a human translator.

safetyPolicy.title: Safety and who Tengo is for
safetyPolicy.lead: How Tengo protects people on shared phones, people who are vulnerable, and children.
safetyPolicy.draft: Draft policy for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer and a safeguarding adviser.

adults.title: Adults only
adults.body: Tengo is for adults. If you are under 18, please do not use it. Saving to an account asks you to confirm you are 18 or older. Tengo does not ask for a date of birth or an ID number, and the fictional demo people are adults.

shared.title: Shared phones
shared.body: You can set a PIN so Tengo locks itself after a few minutes, turn on discreet mode so amounts stay hidden until you tap to show them, and use quick exit to leave Tengo for a plain page straight away. Discreet messages carry no amounts, dates or cover words.

control.title: If someone controls your money
control.body: No one should make you show your forecast, share your PIN or hand over your money. Tengo never asks for a bank password or PIN. If someone checks your phone, quick exit and the PIN lock help, and you can delete your data at any time from Privacy.

care.title: Care for people in a hard spot
care.body: Tengo uses plain words, shows estimates and not advice, and never suggests borrowing, skipping a loan or insurance payment, or cutting stock for a business. When money looks short it points to free help from the National Credit Regulator.

never.title: What Tengo never does
never.body: Tengo does not make lending or credit decisions, does not sell products, and does not share your data with anyone for marketing. Nothing about your forecast is used to judge you.

help.gbv: Gender-Based Violence Command Centre: 0800 428 428, free and open all day and night.
help.childline: Childline, for children and anyone worried about a child: 116, free.

diag.title: Diagnostics
diag.lead: For help with a problem. No personal data is kept here, and nothing is sent.

own.cardPromise: Your numbers, your date. Nothing leaves your device unless you save an account.
own.cardBody: Import a statement, answer a few questions, or try it with sample numbers first. No sign up needed.

welcome.title: Use your own money
welcome.nicknameHint: Only used to greet you. Leave it empty if you prefer.

s1.title: What Tengo asks for, and why
s1.lead: Tengo works out how long your money lasts and when your next money usually lands. It only needs a little to do that.

money.title: Your money in and out
money.body: Dates, amounts and short descriptions, and your balance. From a statement, from a few answers, or from sample numbers.

bills.title: Regular bills and money you owe
bills.body: Things like rent, a phone contract or a stokvel, so Tengo can keep money back for them.

never.title: Never
never.body: Tengo never asks for an ID number, a phone number, a bank login or a PIN.

where.title: Where it stays
where.body: On this device only, unless you later choose to save it to an account. You can delete it any time.

s2.title: Your choices
s2.lead: Only the forecast is needed. Everything else is off until you turn it on.
s2.core: Needed to work out your date. It runs on this device. Withdraw any time and it pauses.
s2.notice: The full privacy notice says what is kept, where, for how long, and how to complain.

s3.title: Add your money
s3.lead: Choose one way. You can change or replace it later on Money.
s3.importBody: A CSV file from your bank. It is read on this device.
s3.manualBody: For when you have no statement. Tengo estimates a starting history from your answers.
s3.sampleBody: Explore without typing anything. The sample is labelled and you can change every number.

s4.lead: This is an estimate from the numbers you gave, not advice. It gets better as you add real entries.
s4.sample: These are sample numbers, not yours. Change them on Money, or replace them with a statement or your own answers.

welcome.signIn: Already saved to an account? Sign in

legalDoc.draft: Draft for the pilot, to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch. Tengo is not a bank and does not give financial advice. This notice does not claim compliance with any law or certification.
legalDoc.placeholderWarning: The responsible party and Information Officer have not been named yet. They must be filled in before any real launch.

what.title: What Tengo keeps
what.body: The money history you add (dates, amounts, short descriptions and categories), your balances, regular bills and money you owe, your choices and settings, an optional nickname, and a log of what you did in the app. If you save an account, your email address too. Tengo does not ask for or keep ID numbers, phone numbers, bank logins or PINs. Long numbers in imported descriptions are masked.

why.title: Why
why.body: Only to work out how long your money lasts, when your next money usually lands, and the estimates on screen. Not for marketing, credit scoring, lending decisions or selling to anyone. Giving the information is voluntary; without it there is no forecast.

where.title: Where it is processed
where.body:
As a guest, everything stays in this browser on this device and the forecast is worked out on the device. Nothing is sent to Tengo.
If you choose to save an account, your data is stored with the database provider named in the setup (Supabase), in the region the operator chooses, and sent over an encrypted connection. The forecast is still worked out on your device. Any storage outside South Africa needs adequate protection under POPIA section 72 and is named here before launch.

who.title: Who can see it
who.body: As a guest: anyone who uses this browser on this device. Use the PIN lock on a shared phone. With an account: you, after signing in. Each person's rows are locked to them in the database. No staff access to your rows is set up. If support ever needs it, this notice will first say how it is limited and recorded.

keep.title: How long it is kept
keep.body: Transactions older than 12 months are removed from this device when Tengo opens. On an account, a server job to remove them is written but not yet switched on. You can delete everything at any time; on an account, deletion removes your rows and your sign-in, and you get a receipt with no personal data. Backups kept by the hosting provider are deleted on their own schedule, stated here before launch.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can see your data and export it as JSON or CSV, correct any entry, ask a person to check a result, withdraw any choice, and delete everything. You can complain to the responsible party above, and to the Information Regulator of South Africa.

not.title: What Tengo is not
not.body: Tengo is a pilot. It is not a bank, not a credit provider and not a financial adviser. Its figures are estimates from your own history, and it makes no decisions about you.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: If this notice changes, the version above changes and Tengo asks you to look at it again before you continue.

use.title: Using Tengo
use.body: Tengo is free to use during the pilot. It is for adults, 18 or older. Use it only with your own money or with pretend numbers.

estimate.title: Estimates, not promises
estimate.body: Every date, budget and suggestion is an estimate from past patterns. Money can arrive late or not at all, and bills can change. Check before you make a decision that matters.

liability.title: Your decisions
liability.body: Tengo does not give financial advice and is not responsible for decisions you make using it. Nothing here limits rights you have under South African law.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: Accounts are optional. Keep access to your email address, because sign-in is by a one-time code. You can sign out everywhere and delete your account at any time.

ending.title: Ending the pilot
ending.body: If the pilot ends, you will be told in the app and given time to export your data before it is deleted.

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.body: Contact the responsible party above. For privacy complaints you can also go to the Information Regulator of South Africa.

account.title: Account
account.unavailable: Accounts are not set up on this copy of Tengo. Your profile stays on this device.
account.lead: Save to an account to keep this on any device. Optional: Tengo works fully without one.
account.leadSaved: Your profile is saved to your account. Your forecast is still worked out on this device.

facts.passwordless: No password: you sign in with a one-time code sent to your email.
facts.device: Your forecast is still worked out on your device. The account only stores your data.
facts.where: Stored with the database provider named in the privacy notice. Only you can read your rows.
facts.leave: Sign out everywhere, export or delete everything at any time.

account.adultHint: Tengo is for adults. It does not ask for or keep a date of birth.

account.emptyLead: Your account is new and empty. Add your money to get your first forecast.

choices.replaceAccount: Replace it with this device's data

account.replaceWarn: Replacing removes what the account holds now and cannot be undone.

account.deleteBody: Removes every row the server holds about you and your sign-in, and gives you a receipt with no personal data. Backups kept by the hosting provider expire on its schedule, stated in the privacy notice.
